premises.text: People needing jobs, opportunities, or advice are limited to their contact list or weak bots rather than chatting with unknown awesome humans
premises.evidence_span: We need to chat with awesome humans that we don't know

premises.text: Sensei is one messenger contact that matches users to humans via NLP intent understanding and a match-and-dispatch algorithm
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is one contact with the experience of millions of people

premises.text: Conversations are anonymous by default, cross-platform, rated, and tippable as a conversation marketplace
premises.evidence_span: Sensei's transactional layer kicks in to allow us to tip our Sensei

premises.text: Sensei expands globally onto LINE, WeChat, and Skype in beta alongside existing messengers and SMS
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is going global, launching in line, WeChat, and Skype in beta

value.text: Getting advice, referrals, opportunities, and jobs by chatting with matched humans
value.evidence_span: They give each other advice, referrals, opportunities, and jobs

secondary_value.text: Future of intelligence is human rather than artificial
secondary_value.evidence_span: the future of intelligence is not artificial. It's human

causal_links.evidence_span: what we really need is human conversation
match you with an awesome human to chat with

notes: NLP, match/dispatch, real-time indexing, and rating UI folded as cascade of one Sensei matching product (§4.1.7). Community size/response/tip metrics treated as traction, not premises.
